subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.

The geologist measured the __________ structure of the mountain.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. stratigraphic .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stratigraphic"** is derived from the term **"stratigraphy"**, which refers to the study of rock layers (strata) and layering.
 
• This word is often used in geology to describe the structural and compositional arrangement of rock layers.
 
• The spelling **"stratigraphic"** is correct and follows the standard conventions of English spelling.
 
• The other options, **"stratographic," "strategraphic,"** and **"stratigrafik,"** are incorrect as they deviate from the correct spelling.

Correct sentence: *The geologist measured the **stratigraphic** structure of the mountain*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Stratigraphy:**

 
 
• Stratigraphy is crucial in understanding Earth's history, including the age and formation process of rocks.
 
• It is widely used in fields like geology, archaeology, and paleontology.
 
 
 
• **Tips for Correct Spelling:**
 
 
• Break the word into parts: "strati-" (layers) + "graphic" (related to writing or description).
 
• Practice spelling technical terms to avoid common mistakes in exams or professional use.
